$comment: Smoke-harness baseline. Recapture DELIBERATELY — never auto-overwrite, or a regression silently becomes the new normal. Elapsed times are indicative (machine, network, model); the assertion COUNTS are the meaningful comparison, because a count dropping means a check silently stopped running. Never capture a baseline with CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL set: a run on substituted models is not a measurement of the product.
subagent_model: as declared per agent (opus/sonnet) — NO override
execution: hooks-health serial (fail-fast), then remaining scenarios concurrent
rationale: Weight sits in the deterministic scenarios because every real defect found in this framework recently was silent ABSENCE — a hook shipped broken for months, five hooks that never shipped, a manifest that never reached the installed plugin, a drift-checker that always exited 0. None announce themselves in use. Prompt-output quality does announce itself, and is the evals' job (deliberately dormant). Verified: reintroducing the permitter into the template triggers four independent failures in scaffold-integrity.
